title: Allow deterministic tool-only procedures to run without agents
description:
As an optimization operator, I want deterministic portfolio procedures that invoke only trusted tools to execute without a synthetic language-model agent, so that read-only ranking and reporting can start safely and predictably.

Out of scope: changing optimizer approval gates, adding model work, or changing score data.

Feature: Tool-only procedure compatibility

Scenario: Run a valid deterministic procedure with no agents
Given a valid Tactus procedure declares no agents and its code uses only registered deterministic tools
When the procedure is executed through the Plexus procedure runtime
Then configuration validation accepts the procedure
And execution reaches the procedure code
And no synthetic agent or model call is required

Scenario: Reject an agent reference without an agent definition
Given a procedure declares no agents
And its code references an agent primitive
When the procedure is validated
Then validation fails with an actionable missing-agent error

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Live acceptance reproduced the defect on the combined integration branch. A valid deterministic portfolio procedure passed Plexus-side validation, created and reused one Procedure Task, then failed before executing its code with: Configuration error: At least one agent must be defined. Procedure and Task reached FAILED; no optimization or evaluation work began. Next: add an outside-in runtime specification, fix the upstream Tactus compatibility boundary, and rerun the same zero-match acceptance.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Closed in board cleanup 2026-10-17: the project is on hold and Ryan called the remaining gaps YAGNI; reopen if they become an issue. Known gap at close: Scenario 1 is evidenced only indirectly (agentless YAML executed via TactusRuntime). No Primus test covers scenario 2 (agent reference without definition -> actionable missing-agent error), no executor-level outside-in spec, and no comment records the fix or rerun acceptance.
